channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Cluster munitions kill, wound over 1,000 globally in 2025
item.description: The 1,063 global casualties in 2025 one of the highest annual tolls on record, a report has found.

item.title: Cameraman catches the moment Yemeni government forces are ambushed
item.description: A suspected-Houthi roadside ambush of Yemeni government forces has been captured on camera.

item.title: Yemen’s Saudi-backed forces strike Houthis on western coast
item.description: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces are intensifying their counteroffensive against the Houthis.

item.title: Jordanian air defences intercept Iranian missile barrage
item.description: Witnesses have captured the moment Jordanian air defence systems intercepted a barrage of Iranian ballistic missiles.

item.title: US strikes 5 Iranian oil tankers; Tehran targets Jordan base, US warships
item.description: US military says it struck the five Iranian tankers after the IRGC targeted a US warship twice in two days.

item.title: Iran war live: US, Iran attack oil tankers; crude heads to $100
item.description: Iran's IRGC urges crews to leave tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain, warning it will target ships following US attack.

item.title: US increases pressure on Iran with sanctions targeting aviation sector
item.description: Trump administration has sought to isolate Tehran through a raft of measures meant to squeeze the country's economy.

item.title: US bombs five Iranian oil tankers after its navy is attacked
item.description: The US military has released video of its forces destroying what it says are five Iranian crude oil tankers.

item.title: US strikes Iranian oil tankers as Tehran targets American base in Jordan
item.description: Oil prices edged closer to $100 a barrel after an escalation in the tit-for-tat strikes between the US and Iran.

item.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
item.description: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.
